name: whoactuallymakes-data
title: Who Actually Makes open data
description: Who makes store-brand products, from public records: Kirkland Signature makers, companies behind store brands, NHTSA tire plant codes, tire age guidance, and the evidence behind each answer.

resources.name: claims
resources.title: Who makes what: store-brand answers (Kirkland Signature)
resources.description: Every store-brand product we can answer from a public record, one row per company the record names: the product, the company, what the record says it did (made, bottled, imported, recalled), the stamp, the dates and lots it covers, the words to look for on the label, and links to the records.

fields.name: claim_id
fields.description: Our ID for the claim. Stable.

fields.name: brand
fields.description: The store brand.

fields.name: product
fields.description: The product, as we name it.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Product category.

fields.name: company
fields.description: The company the record names.

fields.name: company_legal_name
fields.description: Its name as the record gives it.

fields.name: relation
fields.description: made-by, bottled-by, packed-by, imported-by or recalled-by.

fields.name: stamp
fields.description: confirmed, documented, reported or unverified (see /how-we-know/).

fields.name: from
fields.description: Start of what the record covers (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.name: to
fields.description: End of what it covers; blank when open-ended.

fields.name: region
fields.description: Where the record applies.

fields.name: variant
fields.description: Which versions of the product, if the record says.

fields.name: on_label
fields.description: Words to look for on the pack, from the record.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: One sentence on what the evidence shows.

fields.name: evidence_ids
fields.description: IDs of the evidence records, separated by “ | ”.

fields.name: evidence_urls
fields.description: Links to those records, same order.

fields.name: last_checked
fields.description: When we last checked the claim against its records.

fields.name: next_check
fields.description: When it’s next due.

fields.name: page
fields.description: Our answer page, if there is one.

resources.name: companies
resources.title: Companies behind store brands (maker pages)
resources.description: One row per company page: the company, its legal names, what it makes, how many Kirkland Signature claims and products we tie to it, how many other companies a state pet food register lists in its care, how many FDA recalls it has and how many store names those recalls print, and its page.

fields.name: company_slug
fields.description: Our ID for the company page. Stable.

fields.name: company
fields.description: The company, as its page names it.

fields.name: legal_names
fields.description: Legal names of the company and its group companies on the page, separated by “ | ”.

fields.name: website
fields.description: The company’s own website.

fields.name: category
fields.description: What it mainly makes.

fields.name: about
fields.description: One line on the company, from its own statements and the records.

fields.name: kirkland_claims
fields.description: Kirkland Signature claims that name it (see the claims file).

fields.name: kirkland_products
fields.description: Distinct Kirkland Signature products in those claims.

fields.name: register_other_companies
fields.description: Other companies with live registrations in its care on North Dakota’s pet food register; blank if we didn’t read the register for it.

fields.name: fda_recalls
fields.description: FDA enforcement reports (recalls) naming it as the recalling firm; blank if we didn’t read them.

fields.name: fda_recall_store_names
fields.description: Store names printed in the product text of those recalls.

fields.name: plants
fields.description: Plants listed on its page, each from a source.

fields.name: page
fields.description: Our company page.

fields.name: last_checked
fields.description: Latest check of anything on the page.

fields.name: next_check
fields.description: When the earliest claim on the page is next due.

resources.name: company-labels
resources.title: Which store labels each company is on record for
resources.description: One row per link between a company and a brand or retailer: a claim on our answer pages, a registration on North Dakota’s pet food register filed in the company’s care, a store name printed in the company’s FDA recalls, or a brand listed under the company’s API engine oil license. Each row says how many records back it, the dates they cover, and links the record.

fields.name: company_slug
fields.description: The company page this row is on (see the companies file).

fields.name: company
fields.description: The company. For claim rows, the one the record names, which can be a group company.

fields.name: label
fields.description: The store brand or retailer, as we name it.

fields.name: link_kind
fields.description: claim, state-pet-food-register, fda-recall or api-oil-license.

fields.name: detail
fields.description: For a claim, what the record says and the product; for a register row, the registrant name as filed; for a recall row, what the link means; for a license row, the brand names exactly as API lists them.

fields.name: count
fields.description: Claims (1), live registrations (0 = only lapsed ones), recalls that print the store name, or oils listed under the license.

fields.name: first
fields.description: Earliest date the records cover; blank if they don’t say.

fields.name: last
fields.description: Latest date they cover. For a register row, the latest expiry of a live registration; for a license row, when the license expires.

fields.name: record_url
fields.description: The record: claim evidence (separated by “ | ”), the register listing, or the latest recall.

fields.name: read_on
fields.description: When we read the record.

fields.name: company_page
fields.description: Our company page.

resources.name: tire-plants
resources.title: Tire plant codes (NHTSA)
resources.description: Every plant code NHTSA has assigned to a tire factory: the code from the start of a tire’s DOT number, the factory’s name, city, state or province, country and whether it is active.

fields.name: code
fields.description: The plant code: the 2 or 3 characters after “DOT” on a tire.

fields.name: old_code
fields.description: The older 2-character code for the same plant, if NHTSA lists one.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The factory or company name as NHTSA lists it.

fields.name: city
fields.description: City of the factory.

fields.name: state
fields.description: State, province or region of the factory.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country of the factory.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Active, Closed, or blank when NHTSA gives no status.

resources.name: tire-age
resources.title: Tire age guidance from tire makers, carmakers and agencies
resources.description: What each tire maker, carmaker and safety agency says about replacing tires by age, in a row per maker: the age, what it’s counted from, whether it covers the spare, and the document it comes from.

fields.name: group
fields.description: “tire maker or agency” or “carmaker”.

fields.name: who
fields.description: The maker or agency.

fields.name: covers
fields.description: What the advice covers: the kind of source, or for carmakers the model, year and market of the manual.

fields.name: replace_at
fields.description: The age the maker gives, in its own terms.

fields.name: years
fields.description: That age as a number of years, for carmakers; 0 when the manual gives no age.

fields.name: counted_from
fields.description: Where the years count from: manufacture (the DOT date code), fitting, or not stated.

fields.name: spare
fields.description: Whether the advice covers the spare (carmakers).

fields.name: also
fields.description: Other conditions the maker attaches (tire makers and agencies).

fields.name: summary
fields.description: One plain sentence on the carmaker’s advice.

fields.name: source_titles
fields.description: Title of each document, separated by “ | ”.

fields.name: source_urls
fields.description: Link to each document, in the same order.

fields.name: archive_urls
fields.description: Internet Archive copy of each document, where we used one, in the same order.

fields.name: quotes
fields.description: The exact words from each document, in the same order.

fields.name: read_on
fields.description: The date we last read the documents (YYYY-MM-DD).

resources.name: evidence
resources.title: Evidence records: every quote behind our answers
resources.description: Every document we rely on, one row each: the exact quote, the link, the date we read it, an Internet Archive copy where we used one, and the SHA-256 fingerprint of the file as we read it.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Our ID for the record. Stable: it never changes or gets reused.

fields.name: source
fields.description: ID of the source it comes from (see the Sources dataset).

fields.name: publisher
fields.description: Who published the document.

fields.name: type
fields.description: maker-statement or regulator-document.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The document and the section we read.

fields.name: url
fields.description: Where the document lives.

fields.name: archive_url
fields.description: Internet Archive copy we read or saved, if any.

fields.name: retrieved
fields.description: When we read it (YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.name: doc_date
fields.description: The date the document gives itself, if it gives one.

fields.name: quote
fields.description: The exact words we rely on, up to 600 characters.

fields.name: sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the file as we read it.

fields.name: note
fields.description: Page number, how we read it, and anything a checker should know.

resources.name: sources
resources.title: Sources: the public records we use, and their limits
resources.description: Each source we use: who publishes it, whether it is a primary record, what it proves, what it can’t prove, what its terms allow, and how and when we read it.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Our ID for the source.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the source.

fields.name: publisher
fields.description: Who publishes it.

fields.name: url
fields.description: Its home page.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: Kind of source, such as Government registry or Maker.

fields.name: primary
fields.description: true when it is the record itself, not a report about a record.

fields.name: proves
fields.description: What it can prove.

fields.name: cannot_prove
fields.description: What it can’t prove.

fields.name: terms_url
fields.description: Its terms of use or site policies.

fields.name: terms_read
fields.description: What its terms allow, in our words.

fields.name: terms_checked
fields.description: When we last read its terms.

fields.name: credit
fields.description: The credit line the publisher asks for, if any.

fields.name: pulls
fields.description: How and how often we read it, separated by “ | ”.

resources.name: corrections
resources.title: Corrections log
resources.description: Every change to a published answer: what it said, what it says now, why, who spotted it and when. Corrections, updates and clarifications are kept apart.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Our ID for the entry.

fields.name: on
fields.description: When the change went live (YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.name: kind
fields.description: correction, update or clarification.

fields.name: page
fields.description: The page that changed (a path on whoactuallymakes.com).

fields.name: what
fields.description: What changed, in a few words.

fields.name: was
fields.description: What it said before.

fields.name: now
fields.description: What it says now.

fields.name: why
fields.description: Why it changed.

fields.name: flagged_by
fields.description: Who spotted it: a reader, the maker or brand, or our own checks.

fields.name: evidence
fields.description: The records that showed it, separated by “ | ”.

resources.name: schedule
resources.title: Update schedule: when each list is checked
resources.description: Each check we run on a schedule: what it reads, how often, by script or in a browser, when it last ran, when it’s next due and what it found.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Our ID for the job.

fields.name: what
fields.description: What the job checks.

fields.name: source
fields.description: The source it reads.

fields.name: how
fields.description: script or hand.

fields.name: every_days
fields.description: How often it runs, in days.

fields.name: once
fields.description: true for a one-off check.

fields.name: last
fields.description: When it last ran (YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.name: due
fields.description: When it’s next due (YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.name: result
fields.description: What the last run found.

resources.name: costco-diaper-prices
resources.title: Costco diaper prices: every size at every read
resources.description: The box price, count, offer and price per diaper for Kirkland Signature, Huggies Plus, Pampers Swaddlers Ultra, Pull-Ups and Easy Ups on Costco.com, one row per size per read, so prices can be followed over time.

fields.name: read_on
fields.description: The day we read the listing (YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.name: product
fields.description: The product as Costco lists it.

fields.name: size
fields.description: The size on the box.

fields.name: lb_from
fields.description: Lowest weight printed for this size, in pounds. Empty for Newborn.

fields.name: lb_to
fields.description: Highest weight printed. Empty if the size is open-ended, such as 27+.

fields.name: count
fields.description: Diapers or pants in the box.

fields.name: item
fields.description: Costco's item number.

fields.name: regular
fields.description: Regular box price in US dollars.

fields.name: offer
fields.description: Offer price that day. Empty if no offer showed.

fields.name: cents_each
fields.description: What was charged that day, per diaper, in US cents.

fields.name: url
fields.description: The Costco listing.

resources.name: kirkland-vs-pairs
resources.title: Kirkland vs name brands: every pair and its verdict
resources.description: One row per pair of a Kirkland Signature product and a name brand: the verdict worked out from the records, the companies involved, and for medicines the FDA application, holder, strength and form on each label. Some pairs also carry Costco prices.

fields.name: pair
fields.description: Our ID for the pair.

fields.name: group
fields.description: Everyday or Medicine.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Aisle, such as Household or Medicine.

fields.name: kirkland_product
fields.description: The Kirkland Signature product.

fields.name: name_brand
fields.description: The name brand it is set against.

fields.name: name_brand_owner
fields.description: The company behind the name brand, or the company on its label. Empty if we have no record.

fields.name: verdict
fields.description: Our verdict, worked out from the records: Same plant, Same FDA application, Same company, Was, not now, Old record only, Different company or No record yet.

fields.name: stamp
fields.description: How strong the record is: documented or reported. Empty if the verdict rests on no maker claim.

fields.name: companies
fields.description: Companies the Kirkland product is tied to, split by | when more than one.

fields.name: note
fields.description: The limit on this verdict, in a sentence. Often empty.

fields.name: same_active_ingredient
fields.description: true if the two medicines list the same active ingredient. Empty for everyday products and where they don't match.

fields.name: kirkland_strength
fields.description: Active ingredient and strength on the Kirkland label.

fields.name: name_brand_strength
fields.description: The same for the name-brand label.

fields.name: form
fields.description: Dosage form on the Kirkland label, such as powder or tablet.

fields.name: fda_application
fields.description: The FDA application number both labels list. Filled only when the verdict is Same FDA application.

fields.name: fda_holder
fields.description: The holder FDA gives for that application. Filled only with fda_application.

fields.name: other_fda_applications
fields.description: Other application numbers on the name brand's labels, split by |.

fields.name: kirkland_label
fields.description: The Kirkland label on DailyMed.

fields.name: name_brand_label
fields.description: The name-brand label on DailyMed.

fields.name: record
fields.description: The kind of record behind an everyday verdict.

fields.name: record_covers
fields.description: What that record covers.

fields.name: record_date
fields.description: The date of that record, when it has one.

fields.name: price_unit
fields.description: What the prices are per, such as AA battery. Empty for pairs we didn't price.

fields.name: kirkland_cents
fields.description: Kirkland price per unit in US cents.

fields.name: name_brand_cents
fields.description: Name-brand price per unit in US cents.

fields.name: price_read_on
fields.description: The day those prices were read.

fields.name: evidence
fields.description: Evidence record IDs, split by |. They match the Evidence file.

fields.name: answer_page
fields.description: Our page for the Kirkland product.

fields.name: read_on
fields.description: The day the pairs were last built from the records.

resources.name: battery-date-codes
resources.title: Car battery date code rules, by brand
resources.description: How each brand dates its car batteries: where to look, the format, a worked example, and whether the rule comes from the maker or only from a third party.

fields.name: brand
fields.description: The battery brand.

fields.name: standing
fields.description: Where the rule comes from: From the maker, Part maker, part third-party, Third-party only, or No rule we trust.

fields.name: where_to_look
fields.description: Where the code sits on the battery.

fields.name: format
fields.description: How the code is built.

fields.name: example
fields.description: A worked example. Empty if we have no rule.

fields.name: example_means
fields.description: What the example reads as.

fields.name: date_marks
fields.description: What the date marks: Shipped, Made, or Not stated when the record does not say.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Who gives the rule.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: The record.

fields.name: source_date
fields.description: The record's own date, when it has one.

fields.name: read_on
fields.description: The day we read the rule.

resources.name: usda-establishments
resources.title: USDA meat, poultry and egg plants (FSIS directory)
resources.description: Every entry in USDA FSIS's Meat, Poultry and Egg Product Inspection Directory: the establishment number or numbers, the plant's name, other names listed, address, county, the work USDA lists, size band and grant date.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Every number the plant holds, joined with +, e.g. M18532+P18532.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The plant's name as USDA lists it.

fields.name: trade_names
fields.description: Other names USDA lists for the plant, separated by semicolons; blanks such as N/A removed.

fields.name: address
fields.description: Street address.

fields.name: city
fields.description: City.

fields.name: state
fields.description: Two-letter state or territory.

fields.name: postal_code
fields.description: ZIP code.

fields.name: county
fields.description: County.

fields.name: activities
fields.description: The work USDA lists at the plant.

fields.name: size
fields.description: USDA's size band: Very Small, Small, Large, N / A, or blank.

fields.name: grant_date
fields.description: Grant date as USDA lists it. Many show 2021, likely a system date, so don't read them as start dates.

fields.name: fsis_id
fields.description: USDA's internal ID for the plant.

fields.name: lat
fields.description: Latitude from USDA's file.

fields.name: lon
fields.description: Longitude from USDA's file.
